subject: Streamline tenant kickoff — initial API/project seeding & role plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@streamline.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Streamline tenant kickoff — initial API/project seeding & role plan

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call last week. Attaching a short checklist and a proposed seed schedule to get your tenant ready for dev traffic and to hand off to your SRE team. High-level plan below — happy to shift timing if needed.

1) Create tenant namespace and projects (streamline-prod, streamine-staging). Target: week of Aug 9
2) Seed admin API keys (ephemeral CSV delivery) and rotate after first week
3) Invite initial users + map roles (Admin, Developer, Auditor)
4) Confirm audit log retention (default 90 days) and required SSO/KMS details

What I need from you to proceed:
- SRE contact for access validation (name + email)
- Preferred timezone for invite windows (we typically do invites 9–11am PT)
- Any special naming convention for projects or keys

Attachments: streamline-initial-setup-checklist.pdf, seed-schedule.csv (small stubs)

Proposed immediate next steps: I will loop in Karthik (implementation) and Dev (runtime) to generate preseed keys and create the initial projects in a staging tenant on Aug 9. Can you confirm SRE contact and ok for the Aug 9 date?

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com

From: Alex Chen <alex@streamline.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@streamline.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Streamline tenant kickoff — initial API/project seeding & role plan

Thanks Mina — this looks good. A few quick notes:

- Our SRE lead is Priya Rao (priya@streamline.ai), copied here. She prefers invites 11am–1pm ET (we're an east-coast team).
- Can we delay the admin key rotation to day 10 instead of day 7? We have a short freeze this week and want a slightly longer overlap for verification.
- Naming convention: use org prefix "streamline" then env (e.g., streamline-prod). That works for us.

Also, can you confirm whether audit logs are accessible from the console or if we should expect a daily export?

Appreciate it —
Alex
VP Product, Streamline Health
alex@streamline.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Streamline tenant kickoff — initial API/project seeding & role plan

Team — forwarding Streamline confirmation (Priya is SRE, prefers 11am–1pm ET). Alex also asked to delay rotation to day 10. Action items:

- Karthik: please provision tenant namespace "streamline-prod" and a staging env. Target staging creation by Aug 9 EOD PT.
- Dev: create preseed admin keys and place the stub CSV (preseed-keys-stub.csv) in the secure delivery queue. Mark keys as ephemeral and annotate rotation = 10 days.
- Monica: draft the invite batch for Aug 11 at 11:30am ET (invite window Priya requested). Include role mapping: Admin (2 seats), Developer (4 seats), Auditor (1 seat).

Notes on logs/exports: default retention 90 days. We expose logs in console and also can schedule daily export to a supplied S3 if they want longer retention — confirm with Priya if they want export.

Please reply with ETA in-thread. I will keep Alex/Priya copied on the status updates.

Thanks —
Mina

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Streamline tenant kickoff — initial API/project seeding & role plan

Acknowledged — I will provision the tenant namespace and create streamline-staging by EOD Aug 9 PT.

Dev — I will need the preseed key request (scoped to admin) by EOD Aug 6 so we can validate policy bindings before the invite batch.

Monica — will you confirm the final invite list by Aug 10 morning ET so we can run the invite flow on Aug 11 11:30am ET?

Also attaching the internal runbook link for the provisioning steps and the HubSpot deal id for reference.
